title: Look up users by email for the support tool
description: Support agents paste the email a customer wrote in from; this adds a lightweight Dapper repository so the support tool does not need the full EF model.

expected_issues.description: The email is spliced into the SQL with string interpolation, so input like `x' OR '1'='1` changes the query. Use a Dapper parameter: `WHERE Email = @email` with `new { email }`.
The SqlConnection is never disposed, so every lookup holds a pooled connection until finalization and the pool is exhausted under load. Use `await using var connection = new SqlConnection(...)`.
